O Red Bull Bragantino queria entender qu: Red Bull Bragantino wanted to understand what role the club can play in the city where it plays. Studio FH conducted a full territorial diagnosis of Bragança Paulista, researching more than 1,500 organizations, analyzing and describing more than 70 sociocultural clusters, and running two rounds of in-person active listening with community leaders, cultural collectives, schools and public agencies.
O Studio FH estruturou e viabilizou uma: Studio FH designed and delivered a three-module online workshop: an introduction to tax incentive laws, project writing for the Rouanet Law and similar laws, and fundraising strategies with companies.
O clube sustentou o projeto com decisão: The club backed the project with a strategic decision on how deep to go, institutional coordination with the city government, departments and public schools, resources for the activations, and mobilization of its own internal structure to lend legitimacy to the actions. The choice to invest in diagnosis before investing in a volume of events was Red Bull Bragantino's, and it underpins everything that came after.
O programa de embaixadores saiu do papel: The ambassador program got off the ground: 11 leaders and representatives of social organizations in Bragança Paulista now form a network connecting the club to the city's communities. The first meeting took place on August 29 at Nabizão, to present the proposal, share the diagnosis of social needs and hear from those who live these issues every day. One of the challenges the club raised: increasing the presence of residents from the outskirts and rural areas in the stands.
O que ouvimos foi cruzado com os indicad: What we heard was cross-referenced with Bragança's Sustainable Development Goals indicators, prioritizing the areas where the region is most vulnerable.
Organizações do território com repertóri: Local organizations with the know-how to raise funds on their own, increasing the financial autonomy of the network the club now works with.
Organizações que trabalham com mulheres: Organizations working with women in Bragança operate with little visibility and no direct channel to the institutions with the strongest presence in the city.
